'''February 2001 Green Bay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Green Bay, Wisconsin on 25 February 2001. [[Derek Mueller]] won it. It is known from Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1820">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-01-gb-wisconsin-2-25d1820/ gb-wisconsin-2-25], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 1 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-01-gb-wisconsin-2-25d1820/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Green Bay, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Derek Mueller]]
